options.caller_uid_signature: Package Manager assigned app UID; no generic AOSP platform-signature requirement for public Presentation. Honda-specific admission/signature policy UNKNOWN.

options.safe_navigation_rectangle: UNKNOWN; 800x480 logical frame is not physical safe region.
options.window_bounds: Must be bounded to a separately proven physical/logical safe region; no production bounds established.
options.warning_precedence: UNKNOWN against Honda interrupt roots and downstream vehicle warnings.
options.stock_graphics_ownership: Honda ExternalDisplayOutService retains its bottom/main/interrupt roots; independent presentation could overlap.
options.crash_restoration: AOSP framework removes app window on process death; Honda co-composition behavior untested.
options.persistence: App process/package installation lifecycle; installation persists until separately removed.
options.reversibility: App stop/clear and uninstall are potentially reversible but require separately authorized actions.

options.architecture: Temporary shell/native process requests display info or renders directly.
options.required_android_context: Shell process has UID 2000 and can run existing `dumpsys display`; it has no public Android Activity/application window context or app window token. Native Binder access does not itself create app context or bypass service permissions.
options.caller_uid_signature: Shell UID and SELinux domain; exact Honda grants/policy UNKNOWN. Not Honda/platform signed.
options.display_admission: Can request read-only service dump if DUMP is granted; no public Presentation/window admission for this no-APK process has been established.
options.window_bounds: No window token/contract; direct framebuffer and privileged layer routes excluded.
options.crash_restoration: Read-only query exits; no window to restore. Any native rendering lacks a supported teardown contract.
options.persistence: Temporary process only; no app install.
options.reversibility: Read-only query exits without a target change; rendering is not admitted or proposed.
required_honda_evidence: for enumeration, shell DUMP grant and raw service output; for rendering, a separately supported OEM no-APK window/surface contract
approval_required: P2-C5 read-only single-use authorization for diagnostic query only

options.required_android_context: Installed app process with Activity Context, `createDisplayContext`, WindowManager, and framework-issued window token.
options.caller_uid_signature: New Package Manager app UID; request only permissions justified by measured policy. No Honda/platform signature assumed; admission may still be denied.
options.display_admission: Generic API17 behavior verified on isolated emulator; exact Honda behavior UNKNOWN until a separate authorized probe.
options.safe_navigation_rectangle: UNKNOWN and a hard blocker for visible rendering.
options.window_bounds: Start hidden/no-content; any future window must fit a calibrated approved region and avoid stock roots.
options.warning_precedence: UNKNOWN; warning/interrupt testing is a required gate before any visible content.
options.stock_graphics_ownership: Honda retains existing windows and Type110/vehicle graphics; independent app layer must not replace them.
options.crash_restoration: Framework window reclamation observed on API17 emulator only; Honda crash recovery and interaction with service roots require evidence.
options.persistence: Installed package persists; temporary install is still a persistent state until authorized removal/reboot policy is established.
options.reversibility: Potentially reversible by app stop/uninstall, but no cleanup is authorized now; require explicit rollback plan.
approval_required: explicit user approval to relax no-APK constraint
separate authorization for any visible rendering and rollback

options.architecture: A separately approved, reversible deployment mechanism changes the current temporary no-APK constraint without granting privileged access by implication.

options.caller_uid_signature: Must document installed package UID, signer, and permissions; no UID/signature impersonation or privilege bypass.
options.display_admission: UNKNOWN until the resulting caller is separately tested on Honda.
options.safe_navigation_rectangle: UNKNOWN until OEM evidence or calibrated observation.
options.window_bounds: Must be bounded by supported window or adapter API.
options.stock_graphics_ownership: Must preserve Honda renderer, Type110 and warning ownership.
options.crash_restoration: Must have explicit lifecycle, rollback and restart semantics.
options.persistence: Mechanism-dependent; installation/configuration persistence must be described before approval.

separate exact single-use Honda test authorization

global_gates: Display enumeration does not imply window admission.
Window admission does not imply visible or safe rendering.
No temporary native process may bypass Android UID, signature, SELinux, Binder, or WindowManager policy.
No current authorization permits Honda operations, installation, rendering, or configuration changes.
